meaning: Each field is an observation record. Eligibility to run a participant is never stored here; core.eligibility computes it right before each run from these fields, the installed version and the date. observed means the condition was seen to hold; failed means it was seen not to hold; unknown means not observed yet. spec_revision names the participant spec (core.adapters.SPEC_REVISION: argv and mounts) a transport, context or permission observation was made with; a record made with another revision does not allow a run (2026-09-24 review R04).

auth_observed.evidence: W2 and N3: `claude auth status` inside the participant boundary reported loggedIn true, authMethod claude.ai, apiProvider firstParty

transport_observed.evidence: stage 2 b1 and b1-combo (tools/w2/observe.py, claude-sonnet-5): `claude -p` inside the participant boundary read the question from stdin only and exited 0 with a result object (is_error false, subtype success, modelUsage claude-sonnet-5); tree_confirmed_empty true, input_delivery complete. The probes used --output-format stream-json --verbose; the final result event is the object --output-format json prints

context_conformance.evidence: stage 2 b1 (--restricted) and b1-combo (+ --safe-mode): the init event listed tools [Read], no MCP servers, skills or slash commands, only builtin plugins, apiKeySource none. With CLAUDE.md (CM-7Q) and AGENTS.md (AG-5T) in the work folder the answer quoted neither and the model did not read either file. Limit: the 2.1.280 init event has no field for loaded instruction or memory files, so their absence rests on the model's report (K31). ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md does not exist in this distribution

permission_conformance.evidence: stage 2 b1 and b1-combo: Read of another participant's draft outside the work and input folders was denied by the CLI (permission_denied, '--restricted: path outside the working directory'; the boundary does not mount that path either); the input folder was readable; no write tool was offered (tools [Read]) and created.txt did not appear

The model answered the write step without trying it, so the write barrier comes from tools/w2/codex_sandbox.py (no model call): Codex's own Linux sandbox started nested inside the boundary and refused writes to the work folder and /tmp with Read-only file system while reads worked (K12)
